name: Space weather
summary: No geomagnetic or radiation storms; at most G1 forecast
state: NOAA's scales showed no geomagnetic storm or solar radiation storm and at most a minor R1 radio blackout in the 24 hours to 05:40 UTC on 6 Nov; its forecast peaks at a minor G1 level.
for_you: No effect expected on power grids, satellites or GPS.
why: Severe solar storms can disrupt satellites, GPS, HF radio and power grids.
drivers: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections; solar cycle 25 is near its peak.
